notes: Partially guarded exemplar, not a clean one. _fetch() takes a destructured { url, headers, proxy } RequestPayload field; validateUrl() strips brackets before the private-ip check and validateResolvedIp() checks the first resolved address, but fetch() follows redirects and connects to a fresh resolution. The response.url check at line 82 re-validates the final URL only after the redirect hop has already connected, so a 302 to an internal address still issues the request (blind SSRF; response content is withheld). Deterministic G6 at the fetch site (line 64), residual checklist G7 at the dns.lookup site (line 43). Upstream: PR #37 merged the partial guard; PR #45 proposed connect-time pinning and per-hop re-validation and was closed unmerged.
